upstream.description: An AI-powered data science team of agents to help you perform common data science tasks 10X faster.

classification.analysis: AI Data Science Team is a Python library of specialized LLM agents (data cleaning, wrangling, visualization, feature engineering, SQL, EDA, H2O ML, MLflow) built on LangChain/LangGraph-style patterns, plus a flagship Streamlit app called AI Pipeline Studio for visual, reproducible data pipelines. It targets data scientists and ML engineers who want to automate common data-science grunt work using OpenAI or local Ollama models. The repo bundles runnable example apps (pandas analyst, SQL analyst, exploratory copilot) and notebooks demonstrating each agent.

use_cases.title: Automate data cleaning and wrangling with an LLM agent instead of writing pandas by hand
Build a visual, reproducible data pipeline with AI-assisted steps via AI Pipeline Studio
Ask natural-language questions over a SQL database using the SQL Database Agent
Generate exploratory data analysis reports automatically with the EDA Tools Agent
